correctness.rationale: A direct multiplication of the semidirect product yields the right-Engel recurrence. For each v, coprime group-order averaging splits A=C_A(v)⊕(v−1)A, and v−1 is invertible on B_v=(v−1)A. At depth k>=2 the iterated commutator kills the C_A(v) component while pushing a uniformly random A coordinate bijectively across B_v conditional on Y and X complement u. This proves the complete mixture law, character Fourier stabilizer formula, Burnside identity probability and sharp Frobenius equality condition. Solving (v−1)a_B=(u−1)b_B yields the stated conjugate Engelizer with |H||C_v| elements. Noncoprime C8⋊C2 boundary violates stability.
